note: Rayleigh cross sections and optical depths for standard air with a wavelength-dependent depolarization factor; optical depths 1.3% lower to 3% higher in the midvisible and up to 10% higher in the ultraviolet than earlier work; Abstract supports its use as the Rayleigh reference.
